title: Drift Wood #13 · the Grunion Run
arc: French Cinema for the Indifferent / the Grunion Run
logline: A festival for a fish that crawls ashore to breed. Wood hates it. He draws it beautifully.

panels.composition: The beach at night. Lanterns. Half the town with buckets. A banner: SMALL WOOD GRUNION RUN. A GRUNION QUEEN in a sash waves from a flatbed. WOOD, CHLOE and GULLY at the edge.

balloons.text: They come up with the tide. You grab 'em.

image.prompt: a night beach festival with lanterns, townspeople holding buckets at the surf line, a banner and a girl in a sash waving from a flatbed truck, three teenagers at the edge, black and white with heavy blacks

balloons.text: A fish crawls out of the ocean to reproduce and this town throws it a parade. Nobody threw Truffaut a parade.

image.prompt: a teenage boy in an overcoat addressing the night ocean with one arm out, lantern light

balloons.text: Truffaut didn't crawl out of the ocean.

image.prompt: close-up of a teenage girl with one headphone off, dry expression, lanterns behind

panels.composition: Silent. The surf line at the moment the grunion come: hundreds of small silver fish flashing in lantern light on wet sand, buckets, hands, and — small, at the edge — Wood, not moving, looking. The drawing is the best thing in the strip so far.

image.prompt: silent wide panel of a night surf line where hundreds of small silver fish flash on wet sand under lantern light among reaching hands and buckets, a lone teenage boy at the edge standing still, black and white, heavy blacks and bright silver
image.notes: Give this panel more care than the jokes — the Grunion fixture's rule.

notes: The first Grunion Run. The strip hates it and can't stop drawing it.
